title: Per-model Snapshot Studio — Rollout Playback and Cost Lanes
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Engineers and product owners need a compact, correlated view that makes per-model/runtime regressions obvious and ties them to rollout events and cost change drivers. Current route/model pages fragment latency, throughput and token metrics across multiple tabs and lack an actionable playback of historical rollouts or an easy way to attribute token cost changes to rollout variants or quantization changes.

Goal: Design a single 'Snapshot Studio' for per-model and per-route performance that: (1) correlates latency/throughput/token-economics across time, (2) provides a playback timeline of rollouts/variants with the ability to scrub/annotate and compare states, and (3) surfaces "cost lanes" that show cost-per-token drivers (batching, quantization, cache-hit) so teams can quickly decide rollbacks or mitigations.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Snapshot Studio shows p50/p95 latency, requests-per-second (RPS), tokens-in/out and cost-per-1k tokens in a synchronized time scrubber.
2) Rollout Playback timeline displays variant labels, percent traffic, and canary windows; scrubbing updates all charts and surface diffs.
3) Cost Lanes panel breaks down unit cost into CPU/GPU time estimate, batching efficiency, cache-hit delta, and quantization profile change.
4) Drilldown allows selecting a timestamp to open the detailed token ledger and a pre-populated query to the playback trace viewer.
5) All components respect per-route filters (route, region, model-variant, environment) and export snapshots as PNG/CSV.
6) Design implements mobile/tablet responsive behavior for quick ops checks.
7) Usability sign-off from PM and two engineering reviewers recorded in comments.
notes: 2026-02-12: Initial concept sketched — three row layout: timeline + primary charts + cost lanes/token ledger. Feedback: reduce vertical height for primary charts at <1280px width.
2026-02-18: Prototype v1 (figma) created: basic timeline, stacked-line for latency/throughput, small-multiples for token directions, simple cost-lane bar. Link in attachments.
Design trade-offs: chose synchronized scrubbing (client-side) vs server-side snapshot reads due to latency for exploratory debugging. Client-side requires compact sampling (1m/5m) for long ranges.
Telemetry constraints: engineering indicated backend only stores per-minute aggregates for >7d retention — updated widget behavior to show sampled playback for long ranges and full-fidelity for <=7d.
Accessibility: color palette chosen to maintain >=4.5:1 for primary series; cost lanes use patterned fills for monochrome printers.
Performance: microcharts use canvas rendering to support many small-multiples without DOM bloat.
comments: 2026-02-13 — Marco Gonzalez (PM): Love the playback idea. Please add annotation layers for incident links and deploy IDs so SREs can jump to incidents quickly.

2026-02-20 — Liam O'Connor (Eng): Backend can emit deploy metadata (id, tag, user) per minute. We should limit playback to 500 markers per view to avoid UI overload. Can provide a PR with the deploy sample endpoint — see attachments.

2026-02-24 — Evelyn Cho (Designer): Updated prototype with deploy marker clustering and hover cards that show deploy ID + rollout % + PR link. Cluster algorithm collapses markers within 30s on zoomed-out views.
2026-03-02 — Sana Gupta (PM): Request: add 'compare states' mode to lock two timestamps and show delta overlays for latency and cost. Prioritize for beta customers (high impact).
2026-03-05 — Engineering review (pair): noted that KV-cache hit rates are available only per-variant when sampling enabled; added fallback to global cache-hit if variant-level missing.
decisions: Use synchronized scrubbing on the client with sampled aggregates for ranges >7d to keep responsiveness.
Show p50 and p95 latency lines with small-multiple token in/out bars beneath; throughput as an area chart for visual weight.
Implement 'Cost Lanes' as stacked horizontal bars ordered by driver (batching efficiency, quantization change, cache-hit delta, infra minutes); each lane linkable to a cost-explain view.
Support 'Compare States' mode to lock two timestamps and compute deltas; limit to two states to avoid UI complexity.
Export snapshot as PNG (visual) and CSV (raw metrics + deploy metadata).
